input.summary: Remove the one-sided non-solicit/no-hire on Customer in § 12.4, confirming no restriction.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a one-sided bar on soliciting, hiring or employing any Vendor employee for the term plus 24 months with no general-recruitment carve-out, which also contradicts § 12.3 confirming we gave no no-hire commitment. Our position is no non-solicit on the Customer, so we have removed the restriction; if you need protection we can discuss a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, with general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.

ops.oldText: shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies
ops.newText: may solicit, hire, or employ Vendor employees without restriction
